messages:
Zoe: Quick design review  updated invite confirmation + roles legend mocks. Main problems to solve: 1) users confuse "Seats" with purchased licenses, 2) need clearer signal for where a role comes from (org vs team), 3) audit navigation needs faster keyboard stepping. Figma: https://redwood.ai/figma/rbac-legend-v1

Hector: Re: Seats - research quote: "I thought Seats meant how many licenses we bought". Proposal: rename header to "Assigned seats" and add a tiny secondary label: "(active users)". In compact tables shorten to "Assigned".

Mina: Role origin signal: introduce a "policy source badge" (tiny pill) next to the role name: 'Org', 'Team: Product', or 'Template'. Badge should be keyboard-focusable and open a tooltip: "This role is managed by <source>. Click to view policy." Ensure tooltip content is DOM-accessible for screen readers.

Jordan: Accessibility notes: drawer focus trap still failing in the staging build. Repro: open invite drawer -> Tab until SSO toggle -> press Esc -> focus leaves drawer. Fixes: set aria-modal=\"true\" on drawer container, make the close button the first tabbable element, add focus sentinels. Also ensure toasts use role=\"status\" and aria-live=\"polite\".

A11yBot: Automated checks: contrast: role badges in dark mode fall below 4.5:1. Also tooltip dismissal must be keyboard-triggerable (Esc) and return focus to the badge. Toast timing: increase to 6s when a screen reader is detected (avoid missed announcements).

Zoe: Microcopy options for invite confirm when SSO is org-enforced (pick one):
- long: "This organization requires SSO. Invited users must sign in with your SSO provider. See Organization settings."
- short: "SSO enforced. Invited users must sign in with SSO."
We'll use long in modals and short on compact badges.

Hector: Invite expiry presets idea: add quick chips above the Send button: "24h", "7d", "30d", "Never". Default to Never. Also show exact ISO in the confirmation: "Expires: 2026-07-15 (7 days)". Backend note: API needs nullable `expires_at` and `expires_preset`.

Mina: CSV bulk-invite sample (in drawer) should include role_slug and expires_at. Use explicit example and add a dry-run preview. Example: 

```
email,role_slug,expires_at
sam@org.com,team-frontend,2026-06-01
lee@org.com,team-ops,
```

Display per-row validation errors inline after upload. Keep error text concise: "Row 2: unknown role_slug 'team-x'" so logs can be machine-copied.

Jordan: Keyboard shortcuts for power users: propose `g r` for roles grid, `g i` for invite drawer, `g a` for audit. When in audit detail view allow Left/Right to step events and `[` / `]` to jump pages. Add an ephemeral hint pill after first use.

A11yBot: For audit stepping, ensure that moving between events updates an aria-live region with a succinct summary: e.g., "Event 12 of 54: role 'team-ops' edited by Maya". Keep messages short to avoid verbosity.

DesignBot: Prototype v5 pushed: policy source badges, Assigned seats label, expiry chips, CSV sample + dry-run, keyboard shortcuts stub, and accessibility checklist updated (aria-modal, role=status toasts, tooltip focus handling). Figma link updated.

Zoe: Implementation notes for engineers: 1) rename UI labels + add fallback explanatory text, 2) badge component must accept `source` and `policy_id` for deep link, 3) invite API: `expires_at` nullable ISO, `expires_preset` enum, `dry_run` boolean for CSV, 4) audit API should include `policy_id` and `template_id` tokens in event payloads. I'll write a condensed spec and post PR links once ready. Thanks :thumbsup:
